'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a deceased [[NPC]] that first appears in {{Quest|Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens}}. After completing Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens her reverberation can be found in the [[Lost Beyond]].

She can be found talking to '''Grace''' near the well where [[Moon in Water|Phrolova violin is submerged in]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:;'''Grace''' You really don't want to go?.

:'''Ynkwell:''' I want to stick close to home this week. I walked too far with Betty last time, and my feet are still sore.
:'''Grace:''' Oh dear, I forgot you went out not too long ago.
:'''Ynkwell:''' Betty and I went to every clothing shop in all of the nearby cities just to pick out the right skirt  for Phrolova to wear in her performance.
:'''Grace:''' To be fair, it's a nice skirt. Must've taken you ages to find the right one.
:'''Ynkwell:''' Hehe, naturally. We're both excellent shoppers.
:'''Ynkwell:''' I've never seen Betty so picky. As if nothing on display was good enough.
:'''Ynkwell:''' I spent ages trying to get her to make a decision. Otherwise, we'd have had to walk even further to find more shops.
:'''Grace:''' I thought Betty didn't want Phrolova to perform. The poor child was so upset she almost ran off from home.
:'''Ynkwell:''' That's just something Phrolova said out of frustration. She's too stubborn and doesn't want to rely on anything, so she's always ill at ease.
:'''Ynkwell:''' Ahhh, I don't know if that's a good or bad trait...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
* '''Betty''' is heavily implied to be Phrolova mother as she is the one who bought the dress for Phrolova performance out of town<ref>Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens</ref>. However, her reverberation is no where to be found in town.
